test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word.

Trousseau

options.text: The clothes, linen, and other belongings collected by a bride for her marriage
A large cabinet full of expensive clothes
Single leg side of a trouser

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Trousseau: **(दहेज़ के कपड़े और अन्य सामान) - The clothes, household linen, and other belongings collected by a bride for her marriage.

 
 
• **Example**: She spent several months assembling her trousseau for the wedding.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is*** "The clothes, linen, and other belongings collected by a bride for her marriage".***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Being true to oneself: **(अपने आप से सच्चा होना) - Authenticity or fidelity to one's own personality, spirit, or character.
 
• **A large cabinet full of expensive clothes: **(महंगे कपड़ों से भरी एक बड़ी अलमारी) - A furniture piece for storing a vast collection of pricey garments.
 
• **Single leg side of a trouser:** (पैंट की एक साइड की टांग) - Referring specifically to one half or leg portion of a pair of trousers.
